{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric by removing commas
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    ~internal_test_mask
]

# Compute total revenue from completed, non-test orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print the results
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_count}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed, non-test orders: {total_revenue}")

# Return the values for use in submit_answer
internal_test_count, total_revenue"}
